articles.title_ja: Tell HN: Claude is using my limits even though it's infra is failing
articles.summary_ja:
Title: Tell HN: Claude is using my limits even though it's infra is failing
HN text: I am using Claude design, and a lot of times it's agent is failing mid-task, with connection errors (not sure is this connection between me and agent, or between agent in Claude infra and relevant LLM model) When these errors happen: 1. My limits have been consumed already 2. There is no resume button, there is only retry, which starts again 3. Even retry fails, then consumes my tokens. I had some chats where I lost 80% my limits by retrying the task, with no luck of completing it.

articles.title_ja: Ask HN: Is AI destroying public online community as a protective moat?
articles.summary_ja:
Title: Ask HN: Is AI destroying public online community as a protective moat?
HN text: Initially my question was going to be about Reddit and how/why they let it go down the tubes with AI slop and declining confidence in ranking to a human. But as I think through it, the question applies to all of social media. Are they afraid if they meaningfully prevent bots traffic and [perceived] shareholder value will drop? Counter argument is X/Twitter. Musk has contorted it in all sorts of ways, but people stick around anyway.
